payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear explanation of the development of the conceptual model in Figure 2, detailing the thematic analysis process and the factors influencing recycling intention.

claims.text: The conceptual model in Figure 2 was developed through a six-phase thematic analysis that identified and organized themes from focus group discussions (FGDs) related to gamified learning and recycling intention.
The model incorporates themes such as social influence, intrinsic motivation, and extrinsic motivation, which were derived from participant responses during the FGDs.
The development of the model was also influenced by the gamified learning activities that engaged participants and motivated them to recycle.
